description: Canonical token values for the revolt design system. Values are taken from the JSX source (canonical); see notes for derivations.

contrast_pairs.note: Header title is 12px bold uppercase; badges 9px bold.

extras.color.disabled_fill.note: Disabled button fill used by the SVG library (button-disabled); not in the JSX, whose palette has no disabled state.

color.surface_selected.note: Selected sidebar item: lime fill + 2px black border + 3px hard shadow.

color.surface_inverse.note: Black is a structural colour in the JSX, never a surface; the inverse pair is black fill with white text.

color.text_placeholder.note: Live CSS: placeholder is text_primary at opacity 0.4 (uppercase).

color.accent_foreground.note: Header bar, user messages and unread badges: white on pink (JSX table 4.2:1; measures ~3.5:1 — flagged for the contrast gate). Contrast fix (#7): #FFFFFF -> #111111. White cannot get lighter; the minimum passing move is to #212121, snapped to the system black #111111 because the five-colour palette is inviolable (pink #FF3366 signature unchanged). [color.accent_foreground on color.accent 3.55:1 -> 5.32:1 (min 4.5:1)]

color.action.note: Lime is the action colour: send button, selected state ('Active states, send button').

color.danger.note: Five-colour palette is inviolable — status reuses it. Danger = pink with black text (5.3:1; white is 3.5:1).

color.warning.note: Black pill with lime text; distinguished from info by its label and foreground.

color.focus_ring.note: JSX removes outlines and defines no focus style. Pink (3.5:1 on cream) at the structural 3px width.

type.display.note: JSX type table gives size/weight/tracking only; line_height 1.2 is derived for display/title/label (body 1.5 is live).

space.md.note: Not named in JSX; 10-12px are the recurring paddings.

motion.fast.note: JSX Hover Rotation tokens: duration 120ms, easing linear ('Mechanical snap'); list rows 'transition: transform 0.12s' (rotate -0.5deg). .snd scales at 0.1s. Selection doc row: '150ms linear (instant)'. exit_ms is derived (~0.7 x enter, the fine-design ratio): the JSX has no exit animations; React unmounts instantly.

motion.moderate.note: JSX .ci list rows: 'fadeSlideUp 0.2s linear', 50ms stagger. exit_ms is derived (~0.7 x enter, the fine-design ratio): the JSX has no exit animations; React unmounts instantly.

motion.slow.note: JSX .mi messages: 'fadeSlideUp 0.25s linear', 60ms stagger. The doc row says 300ms ease-out; the implementation value is used. exit_ms is derived (~0.7 x enter, the fine-design ratio): the JSX has no exit animations; React unmounts instantly.

motion.expressive.note: Not used by the JSX. Takes the doc row's 300ms; linear and springless to stay mechanical.

motion.reduced_motion.note: The JSX has no prefers-reduced-motion query: every animation (including the staggered entrances) plays regardless of the user setting. Revolt's motion is a mechanical snap, so reduced motion removes it (no rotation, instant entrances).

color.text_muted.note: Contrast fix (#7): #999999 -> #949494. minimum OKLCH lightness change that passes, hue and chroma kept. [color.text_muted on color.surface 2.85:1 -> 3.03:1 (min 3.0:1)]

hue_waivers.reason: Owner decision, confirmed 2026-10-26 (ADR-0002): the five-colour palette is inviolable (JSX: 'No new colors'), so danger reuses the accent pink #FF3366; any danger 40° of hue from pink would be a sixth colour. Errors are carried by the uppercase ERROR status label (JSX status pill variants LIVE / TYPING / OFFLINE / ERROR) and black text on pink (danger_foreground #111111), per spec.yaml rulebook revolt-error-status. action (lime) clears the gate at 110.6°.
